summary: Iteration 6: Verified two fixes — (1) top-level GET /health added to FastAPI, (2) AuthDialog Google redirectUrl = window.location.origin. Backend: 44/44 pytest passing (added TestHealth::test_health_root_no_api_prefix + test_api_root_still_works). /health returns 200 {status:healthy} on backend pod directly at http://localhost:8001/health — which is what the K8s liveness probe actually hits. Note: via public ingress (preview URL), /health without /api routes to the frontend and returns index.html; that is EXPECTED because the ingress only forwards /api/* to backend 8001. K8s probes bypass the ingress. All /api routes still functional: /api/ root=200, /api/games/slots returns exactly 6 machines with expected IDs. Auth JWT flows (register 10k balance + cookie, login, /auth/me bearer, admin login, duplicate/invalid guards) all pass. Gameplay regression: slots spin decrements balance & returns net (verified in UI 10000->9900 on gates_of_glory), keno play returns hits/multiplier/win, coinflip heads/tails, bonus status+claim+cooldown, cashback status + Private-tier auto-grant + history, leaderboard, 8 VIP tiers, 5 payments packages, checkout session created. Frontend smoke: Landing, /lobby (6 slot cards), slot SPIN on gates_of_glory, /wallet, /legal/terms, /legal/privacy all load. Zero non-401 console errors. 'War of Wages' typo not present anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 800+ lines (>700); consider splitting into routers (fleet/cashback/payments) — carryover from prior iterations.
/api/fleet/enquiry still has no auth and no rate limit — carryover, spammable.

/health lives on the top-level app (outside the /api router) which is correct for the k8s probe. If a future preview-ingress test is desired, expose /api/health as well so it can be verified through the public URL — currently only reachable on the pod directly.
